headline: Tehran will deliver a 'crushing response' to any attack
dek: Baqaei said nothing has been agreed during the latest exchange of peace proposals with the US, though talks continue through mediators; 'Past experiences close the door on any optimism regarding America's seriousness in diplomacy.' Tehran is prepared to defend itself and deliver a 'crushing…
sources: Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei, via state-run IRNA, relayed by Al Jazeera and Dawn liveblog
fault_line: Deal 'could happen' (Trump/Vance) vs 'nothing agreed' (Baqaei) -- who is describing the talks honestly on the eve of the post-midterm window?

sections.what_happened: Baqaei said nothing has been agreed during the latest exchange of peace proposals with the US, though talks continue through mediators; 'Past experiences close the door on any optimism regarding America's seriousness in diplomacy.' Tehran is prepared to defend itself and deliver a 'crushing response' to any attack, while not missing any diplomatic opportunity.
sections.what_verified: IRNA (T3, STATE IR) as origin; Al Jazeera (T2, STATE QA) and Dawn (T3) relays of the same primary statement.
sections.what_disputed: Trump and Vance signalled progress the same day (Vance: 'progress' in indirect talks; Trump: deal 'could happen'); Rezaei's separate X statement (1900-02) said the US response was 'not convincing' -- consistent with Baqaei on substance, divergent from the US progress framing. Distinct from military spokesman Akraminia's separate 'crushing response' warning carried by Ynet.
sections.why_matters: Same day, opposite readouts: Washington says progress, Tehran says nothing agreed -- and the 'crushing response' warning attached
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Dawn live 08:57pm PKT = 19:57 , in the 19:00-20:00 window but missed by the 2000 scan; AJ liveblog retitled to this framing by 22:58 ) -- Baqaei: nothing agreed in latest US exchange; Tehran will deliver a 'crushing response' to any attack

totw_analysis: Our read: Same day, opposite readouts: Washington says progress, Tehran says nothing agreed -- and the 'crushing response' warning attached The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deal 'could happen' (Trump/Vance) vs 'nothing agreed' (Baqaei) -- who is describing the talks honestly on the eve of the post-midterm window?
